pre_registered_collection_horizon.start_rationale: Strictly after this registration timestamp and after the next UTC midnight, so no already-written byte is inside the horizon. Also strictly after 2026-09-01, excluding the 2026-08-31 bring-up outage (34.0 min and 73.6 min index gaps) documented in the collector audit.
pre_registered_collection_horizon.end_rule: The horizon closes at the FIRST UTC midnight at or after start + 28 days at which the eligibility conditions below are all met. If they are not met by start + 90 days the horizon closes UNMET and the design is retired without an outcome read.
pre_registered_collection_horizon.no_extension_clause: The horizon may never be extended, re-anchored, or restarted to reach a sample. An unmet horizon is a terminal UNMET record, not an inconclusive to be retried.

eligibility_conditions_for_the_horizon_t.monotonicity: zero data-record monotonicity violations inside the horizon
eligibility_conditions_for_the_horizon_t.byte_integrity: every horizon day file hashed at horizon close and pinned before any signal is computed
eligibility_conditions_for_the_horizon_t.restart_policy: process restarts are permitted and must be counted; a restart that loses more than 15 minutes voids the affected day

binding_constraints_if_it_is_ever_run.ordinal: consumes the next unused ordinal; at k=8 that is alpha_8 = 0.0006944444444444445
binding_constraints_if_it_is_ever_run.alpha_note: Registering a horizon spends no alpha. Alpha is consumed only when a mechanism is selected against it. This file deliberately does NOT select a mechanism.
binding_constraints_if_it_is_ever_run.freeze_order: mechanism + gates + thresholds + runner + tests must be hash-frozen and reviewed BEFORE the horizon closes, and the contract sha256 recorded here, so that no threshold can be chosen after seeing the sample.
prohibited: reading any outcome before the contract is frozen
any deployment, capital-allocation or tradable-alpha claim
binding_constraints_if_it_is_ever_run.claim_boundary: A pass would establish only that a pre-registered rule survived one prospective window under its own gates. It would not establish tradable alpha, causality, capacity, or deployment readiness.

what_this_registration_does_not_do: It does not select a mechanism.
It does not choose a signal, an outcome variable, or a threshold.
It does not consume an ordinal or any alpha.
It does not authorize a runner to be written.
It does not reopen any closed family.
